title: Purchasing Agent
description:
Role Title: Purchasing Agent
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Purchasing Agents to contribute to a customer's project focused on advancing AI systems in the procurement domain. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Design and author expert-level procurement tasks reflecting real-world complexity, including RFP drafting, bid evaluation, supplier scoring, and contract negotiation scenarios.

• Source, create, and format realistic procurement artifacts such as supplier quotations, specifications sheets, pricing tables, and technical documentation in multiple inconsistent formats.

• Define defensible sourcing recommendations with clear, well-reasoned justifications that mirror sophisticated procurement decision-making.

• Develop comprehensive grading rubrics to be used by AI grading agents, focusing on accurate evaluation of agent performance in vendor comparison, contract reasoning, and bid analysis.

• Ensure tasks accurately represent the granular challenges of procurement in specialized domains such as IT, industrial, or professional services.

• Provide clear, well-structured written and verbal communication to articulate procurement challenges, task context, and evaluation standards.

• Collaborate with micro1 ’s project team to review, refine, and validate created tasks and rubrics for quality and relevance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum 4 years of proven experience in corporate or public-sector procurement, with direct responsibility for supplier analysis, bid matrices, and contract negotiation.

• Demonstrated expertise in analyzing non-standardized vendor submissions and producing detailed comparison matrices.

• Deep category knowledge in IT, industrial, or professional-services procurement, enabling nuanced scenario creation and evaluation.

• Exceptional written English skills, with advanced ability to author technical procurement documentation and articulate contract rationale.

• Strong foundation in procurement best practices, regulatory frameworks, and supplier evaluation methodologies.

• Experience with creating or assessing complex procurement scenarios or benchmarks is a plus.

• Proven attention to detail, analytical mindset, and a commitment to high-quality deliverables in demanding technical contexts.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Senior Accountant to join our team.

Position Description

The Senior Accountant will be a key member of Oklo's accounting team, with primary responsibility for preparing and posting journal entries and completing timely, accurate account reconciliations as part of the monthly and quarterly close process. This role will own assigned close activities, investigate and resolve reconciling items, maintain clear supporting documentation, and help ensure the general ledger is complete and accurate. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, and able to meet close and SEC reporting deadlines while partnering effectively with teams across the business.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Prepare and post recurring and non-recurring journal entries in NetSuite, including accruals, prepaids, allocations, reclassifications, and other month-end adjustments

• Maintain complete journal-entry support and ensure entries are accurate, appropriately approved, and posted within the close timeline

• Complete assigned balance sheet and income statement account reconciliations in FloQast and tie balances to the NetSuite general ledger

• Research, document, and resolve reconciling items and unusual account activity on a timely basis

• Own assigned monthly and quarterly close tasks in FloQast and proactively communicate status, issues, and dependencies

• Run and analyze NetSuite general ledger, trial balance, and transaction-detail reports to support close activities and account reconciliations

• Prepare account roll-forwards, supporting schedules, and variance analyses for management and financial reporting review

• Partner with accounts payable, payroll, procurement, and other business teams to obtain complete and accurate information for journal entries and reconciliations

• Support quarterly and annual financial reporting activities, including schedules used in SEC reporting

• Execute assigned internal controls and maintain documentation in accordance with company policies and SOX requirements

• Provide schedules and supporting documentation to internal and external auditors and respond to audit requests

• Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and automate journal-entry, reconciliation, and close processes

• Assist with accounting research and special projects, including documenting conclusions and proposed accounting treatment

• Perform other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

• Three to five years of progressive general accounting experience, including hands-on month-end close responsibilities

• Demonstrated experience preparing and posting journal entries and completing balance sheet account reconciliations

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and proficiency with Microsoft Excel

Bonus Qualifications:

• Big 4 Preferred, CPA is a plus

• Master’s degree in accountancy

• Fast growth startup or public company experience

• Hands-on experience using NetSuite for general ledger accounting and financial reporting

• Hands-on experience using FloQast for account reconciliations and close management

• Experience reconciling and recording Stock Based Compensation & Payroll

Competencies

We are looking for someone that is:

• Close ownership - takes responsibility for assigned tasks and consistently meets monthly and quarterly close deadlines

• Attention to detail - prepares accurate journal entries and reconciliations supported by clear, complete documentation

• Analytical thinking - understands account activity, identifies unusual items, and explains period-over-period changes

• Problem solving - researches and resolves reconciling items and accounting issues in a timely manner

• Organization - manages multiple accounts, schedules, and deadlines in a fast-paced close environment

• Systems proficiency - works efficiently in NetSuite, FloQast, and Excel and can

title: Structural Integrity Engineer
description:
Intertek , Multinational Company leader in ATIC (Assurance, Testing, Inspection, Certification) is seeking an experienced Structural Integrity Engineers for upcoming work related to operational plants, brownfield modifications, and revamp projects across multiple Energy assets. This role focuses on evaluating the structural condition of existing facilities, assessing degradation, verifying load capacity, and supporting engineering decisions related to life extension, structural tie-ins and structural reliability.
The Structural Integrity Engineer provides technical authority in structural assessment, load evaluation, and degradation‑related structural engineering, ensuring that all recommendations are technically defensible, compliant with international codes, and aligned with Client integrity requirements.
Responsabilities:

• Perform structural integrity assessments for non‑pressurized structural elements, including pipe racks, platforms, walkways, supports, buildings, foundations, and steel frames.

• Evaluate corrosion‑related section loss, deformation, vibration issues, and structural overstress conditions.

• Conduct load evaluations (dead, live, thermal, wind, seismic, equipment loads) for existing structures.

• Assess structural adequacy for revamp scopes, equipment replacement, and structural tie‑ins.

• Support API 579 Part 5/9 assessments only where applicable to structural components (e.g., local thin areas, crack‑like flaws).

• Review legacy structural drawings, as‑built documentation, and field measurements to validate structural capacity.

• Evaluate use of existing structures for new loads or modified operating conditions.

• Provide structural input to revamp engineering packages, MOCs, and tie‑in feasibility studies.

• - Support temporary works, lifting studies, and construction‑related structural checks.

• - Interpret inspection data and correlate degradation mechanisms with structural performance.

• - Prepare structural assessment reports, engineering justifications, and recommendations for repair, reinforcement, or replacement.

• - Interface with Mechanical, Corrosion, Process, and Inspection teams to resolve data gaps and ensure alignment.

• - Ensure compliance with Eurocodes, AISC, ASCE, API, and Client standards.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. Master’s degree in Structural Engineering is an advantage.

• Minimum 5 years demonstrable experience acting as Structural Integrity Engineer.

• Experience with structural analysis software for assessment‑level calculations

• Chartered Engineer (CEng / PE / EUR Ing) or equivalent.

• API 579 familiarity (Parts 5 & 9) is an advantage.

• Training in structural assessment, Eurocodes, or API/ASME integrity standards.

• Strong understanding of structural analysis principles, load combinations, and code‑based assessment methods.

• Proficiency in evaluating non‑pressurized structural elements: steel structures, concrete structures, pipe racks, platforms, supports, and foundations.

• Ability to assess corrosion, section loss, deformation, vibration, and fatigue‑related issues.

• Familiarity with operational constraints, plant walkdowns, and brownfield engineering practices.

• Working knowledge of integrity management systems and inspection workflows.

title: Financial Lines Claims Counsel
description:

Company Overview:
MSIG USA is the US-based subsidiary of MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc., one of the world’s top P&C carriers and a global Class 15 insurer, with A+ ratings and a reach that spans 40+ countries and regions. Leveraging our 350-year heritage, MSIG USA brings the financial strength, expertise, and global footprint to offer commercial insurance solutions that address your business’s unique risks.
Summary :
As the Financial Lines portfolio continues to grow, the Financial Lines Claims Counsel will play a meaningful role in the development of the Financial Lines Claims organization. This position manages high-exposure and complex Financial Lines claims and brings deep expertise in Financial Lines coverage and claims handling. The role focuses primarily on Directors & Officers (D&O), Financial Institutions Professional Liability (E&O), Employment Practices Liability (EPL), Fiduciary, and Fidelity claims, including complex litigation, class actions, securities matters, and high-severity financial loss exposures. The position offers significant autonomy, visibility, and the ability to influence claim outcomes and the continued expansion of the business.
Essential Functions :

• Manage a diverse portfolio of complex Financial Lines claims from initial notice through resolution.

• Analyze coverage, liability, damages, and exposure issues, establish appropriate reserves, and provide accurate claim assessments involving D&O, Financial Institutions E&O, EPL, Fiduciary, and Fidelity policies.

• Draft coverage position letters, reservation of rights letters, and other claim-related communications.

• Evaluate and manage high-severity matters, including securities litigation, class actions, regulatory investigations, and complex commercial disputes.

• Develop and execute strategic claim resolution plans, including settlement negotiations within delegated authority and escalation of matters requiring higher-level approval.

• Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation strategy while controlling legal spend.

• Collaborate with underwriting, actuarial, legal, and senior leadership on emerging risks, claim trends, and portfolio performance.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with insureds, brokers, defense counsel, and business partners.

• Prepare claim summaries, authority requests, and management reports while maintaining accurate claim documentation and file records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to the continued growth and development of the Financial Lines claims operation.

Education and Experience :

• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.

• Active bar admission in at least one U.S. jurisdiction and in good standing.

• 7+ years of experience handling Financial Lines claims, coverage litigation, or complex commercial litigation.

• Strong knowledge of D&O, Financial Institutions E&O, EPL, Fiduciary, and Fidelity coverages.

• Experience evaluating complex coverage issues and large-loss exposures.

Other qualifications and skills :

• Carrier or broker-side Financial Lines claims experience preferred.

• Experience handling claims involving financial institutions, private equity firms, investment managers, or other complex financial organizations preferred.

• Background managing securities claims, class actions, regulatory matters, and high-exposure commercial disputes preferred.

• Experience working with primary policies preferred.

title: Design Lead

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Go/MongoDB
description:
MongoDB Tools Team
Team: MongoDB Tools (Product and Engineering)
Location: Remote
Projects: percona/percona-clustersync-mongodb and percona/percona-backup-mongodb
About the team
The MongoDB Tools Team builds Percona 's open source operational tooling for MongoDB. Two projects sit at the center of what we do. Percona ClusterSync for MongoDB (PCSM) clones and continuously replicates data between clusters. Percona Backup for MongoDB (PBM) is a distributed, low-impact backup and restore solution for replica sets and sharded clusters. Both are written in Go, both are Apache 2.0 licensed, and both are built fully in the open.
This role sits primarily on PCSM, which is younger and moving fast, so you will have real influence over how it takes shape. You will also work across into PBM. The two tools share many hard problems: cluster topology, the oplog and change streams, consistency across shards, and performance in very large production clusters. Backup and restore experience is a real advantage here, not just a box to tick.
The projects

• PCSM (primary focus): initial data cloning followed by continuous change replication over MongoDB Change Streams, for both replica sets and sharded clusters. Still pre-1.0 and evolving quickly.

• PBM (secondary): consistent backup and restore with point-in-time recovery, using oplog capture to stay consistent across replica sets and sharded clusters, with S3-compatible and filesystem storage. Driven by pbm-agent processes on each node and a pbm CLI. Mature and widely deployed in production.

What you will work on
Primary, on PCSM

• The core replication engine: initial collection cloning followed by continuous change capture over MongoDB Change Streams, with correct handling of resume tokens, ordering, and resumability after failures.

• Correctness and fault tolerance at scale: recovering cleanly from network drops, primary elections, and restarts without losing or duplicating changes, and reasoning carefully about the delivery guarantees we can honestly promise.

• Sharded cluster support: replicating across shards, dealing with the realities of chunk migrations and balancer activity, and keeping the target consistent.

• Namespace filtering and automatic index management, plus the edge cases that show up with DDL, TTL, and index differences between source and target.

• Performance and throughput: parallelizing the clone, applying backpressure, and keeping memory and connection use sane against large clusters with great change volume.

• The CLI and HTTP API that drive and observe a sync, and the metrics and logging that let an operator trust what is happening.

Also across PBM

• Consistent backup, restore, and point-in-time recovery across replica sets and sharded clusters, using physical or logical type of the backup.

• Backup storage: integrating reliably with main cloud object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage...) and remote filesystems, and handling the throughput and failure modes that show up at scale.

• The pbm-agent and pbm CLI, and the control-collection state in MongoDB that coordinates them across the cluster.

Shared across both

• Working in the open: pull requests, code review, JIRA, and the community forum.

• Release quality: tests, packaging, and the CI and security scanning that gate every change.

What Have You Done:

• Strong Go experience in production, with real fluency in concurrency: goroutines, channels, context cancellation, worker pools, and backpressure. You have debugged a race condition that only showed up under load, and you know how you found it.

• Solid grounding in distributed systems and data consistency. You can talk clearly about at-least-once versus exactly-once, idempotency, ordering, and what it takes to make a stateful process resumable.

• Hands-on MongoDB knowledge: change streams, the oplog, resume tokens, replica sets, and sharding. You do not need to have built replication before, but you should understand why it is hard.

title: Creative Command Center Lead
description:
About NewWorld

NewWorld is a media company that restores our ability to imagine a world better than the one we inherited. We build the stories, worlds, and communities where that future stops feeling radical and starts feeling popular, possible, and ours to demand and get.

We do this three ways: original shows we own, strategy and Command Center services we deliver for clients, and shows with charitable purpose commissioned through our Media Fund. One studio, one method, one point of view.

What a Creative Command Center does

A Command Center is a small, senior, always-on team that connects four things normally kept apart: research (rigorous information on audiences and what/who they tune into), creators (the people our audiences usually trust more than other institutions), production (content shipped at the speed of the platforms), and amplification (taking the best and most responsive content and moving it creatively through the algorithm).

A Command Center works in two stages. The first is activation, which means identifying the voices a particular audience already trusts and briefing them well enough that they will speak in their own words about something they had not previously been talking about. Those voices are rarely the client's own channels and never paid spokespeople reading from a script. We are connecting to the credibility of creators, commentators, community figures and coalition partners who have standing we cannot manufacture ourselves.

The second stage is amplification, and it is where most creator programs fail. A creator post that reaches only its own following remains a piece of content, while the same post picked up by amplifier accounts, placed behind paid social and digital, pitched into earned media, extended into out-of-home or a live event, and coordinated with distribution partners becomes the conversation itself. Making that happen requires directing a bench of specialist vendors so that their work compounds rather than running in parallel lanes, which is a large part of this job.

The Command Center operates in both directions. Reactive work means breaking a false or predatory story before its frame hardens, on a timeline measured in hours rather than weeks. Proactive work means setting the terms of a conversation before anyone else has the chance to.

Earlier this year we built a Command Center for a candidate facing roughly $10 million in attack spending from pro-AI-industry groups, beginning from almost no name recognition. The work generated 22 million views in a district of 750,000 voters and more than a million engagements, outperforming the industry engagement benchmark by a factor of three and paid engagement by nearly twelve. He finished within four points of winning, and the attack that was meant to end his candidacy became the thing his campaign was best known for.

The role

You will run 1-2 Creative Command Centers. The work involves turning a narrative strategy into an operation that ships on a reliable cadence: setting the operating rhythm and the approval paths, writing and commissioning the briefs, building and managing the roster of trusted voices, and directing the vendors who amplify them so that paid media, creator management, earned media and production are all working from one calendar and one set of metrics. You will also be the senior NewWorld person in the room with the client, which means you are trusted to make decisions without checking first.

title: Associate Materials Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

Materials Engineer will perform material selection, qualification, testing and analysis of composite materials used in satellite structures, supporting material and design qualification for space applications. This role executes thermal, mechanical, and microstructural testing, interprets and cross-correlates results to assess material integrity, and documents findings that support qualification of flight hardware materials.

Key Responsibilities:

• Plan and execute mechanical, thermal, and microstructural testing of composite materials and structural components specific to satellite hardware.

• Operate and interpret data from DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry), DMA (Dynamic Mechanical Analysis), UTM (Universal Testing Machine), surface energy analyzer, optical microscopy, profilometry and other composite and polymer testing.

• Cross-correlate results across test methods to assess material integrity, performance, and failure behavior.

• Perform statistical analysis of test data, including B-basis allowable development, and apply design of experiments to test planning.

• Support material and design qualification campaigns for space applications, from coupon-level testing through structural component validation.

• Design and oversee qualification procedures for composite materials and structures, including test plans, acceptance criteria, and execution against space program requirements.

• Document findings in test reports, data packages, and qualification records that support material qualification and program milestones.

• Partner with Design, Structures, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to translate test results into material selection and design decisions.

 Education:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

• Working knowledge of thermal, mechanical, and microstructural characterization methods and data interpretation

• Proficiency with CAD software (Autodesk Inventor, AutoCAD, and SolidWorks) for reviewing designs and developing test fixtures.

• Strong understanding of the mechanics of composite materials, including failure criteria.

• Experience with DSC, DMA, UTM, optical microscopy, and profilometry, and with composite testing generally.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next.

You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role.

We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next.

WHY THIS ROLE

Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams.

- Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team.

- Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced.

- Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly.

- Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff.

- Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck.

- Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows.

- Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: c

ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
ASRC Federal is seeking a ITSM Team Lead to support the DoS STS program Position Summary The ITSM Team Lead, ServiceNow leads day-to-day functional support and continuous improvement of ServiceNow capabilities supporting enterprise IT operations. The role coordinates stakeholder requirements, enhancements, testing, reporting, user support, and process improvement while providing direction to the ITSM team and serving as a liaison between stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership. Key Responsibilities

• Lead intake, analysis, prioritization, and tracking of ServiceNow requirements and enhancement requests.

• Translate business and operational needs into functional requirements, user stories, test scenarios, and implementation actions.

• Coordinate enhancements through requirements validation, UAT, defect resolution, production release, and stakeholder communication.

• Provide functional leadership for ServiceNow ITSM processes, reporting, dashboards, CMDB-related activities, and supported scoped applications.

• Oversee troubleshooting, user support, training, and coordination of issue resolution with technical teams.

• Develop operational, queue-management, executive, and performance reporting using ServiceNow reporting and Platform Analytics.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, automate manual activities, strengthen data quality, and standardize ITSM processes.

• Provide day-to-day direction, mentoring, workload coordination, and quality oversight for ITSM team members while communicating priorities, risks, and status to leadership.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in IT service management, ServiceNow, business analysis, reporting, or related enterprise IT operations.

• Experience gathering requirements, coordinating ServiceNow enhancements, leading UAT, and supporting production releases.

• Strong functional knowledge of core ITSM processes, including Incident, Request, Change, and Configuration Management.

• Experience developing dashboards, operational metrics, and management reporting in ServiceNow or comparable platforms.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• ServiceNow, ITIL, and/or PMP certification.

• Experience supporting a federal government or other large, regulated enterprise environment.

• Experience with ServiceNow Platform Analytics, CMDB, Discovery, scoped applications, or workflow automation.

• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

title: Founders Office
description:
This is a remote position.

About the Role

This is a founder’s office role. You’ll work directly with Aj (founder) on GTM execution, internal ops, and whatever else needs to get done to move the company forward. There’s no clean job description here. Some weeks it’s building outreach systems. Some weeks it’s competitive research. Some weeks it’s figuring out why a process is broken and fixing it. The thread connecting all of it: speed, judgment, and an AI-first approach to everything. We’re hiring for someone who’s hungry, sharp, and already deep into AI - not someone who wants to get into AI.
What You’ll Work On • GTM support - outreach campaigns, lead research, pipeline ops, follow-up systems • Internal ops - building and automating processes that let a small team punch above its weight • Research & analysis - market research, competitor mapping, client/prospect context • Content & communication- drafts, decks, summaries - whatever the founder needs turned around fast • Ad hoc projects - if it matters to the company right now, it’s on the table

Requirements

What We’re Looking For Non-negotiables: • You’ve built something with AI. Not a tutorial. Not a prompt collection. An actual tool or product - even if just for yourself - using Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar. We’ll ask you about it. • You move fast. Not “I work hard” fast - demonstrably fast. You bias toward doing over planning. • You learn quickly and openly. You don’t need to know everything coming in. You do need to figure things out without being hand-held. • You write clearly. Not beautifully - just clearly and quickly. • You have good judgment about what matters and what doesn’t.
Highly preferred: • Some exposure to B2B GTM, sales ops, or startup environments • Comfortable with tools like Clay, Notion, Make/Zapier, HubSpot, or equivalents - or fast enough to pick them up • You follow the US startup ecosystem - you know who YC is, what pre-seed means, why founder-led sales works • You’re the person in your friend group who’s already automated something everyone else still does manually
What This Is Not • A structured program with defined learning goals. There’s no curriculum. • A comfortable 9-to-5. The work is real and the pace is real. • A stepping stone you phone in. If you’re not genuinely excited about AI and startups, this will be obvious fast.
What You Get • Direct access to a founder running two companies across AI product and services • You’ll see the full picture - GTM, ops, client work, strategy - not a slice of it • Fast career surface area. If you’re good, you’ll own things quickly. • Competitive comp for the role level
Apply by telling us two things: what you’ve built with AI, and the last thing you figured out completely on your own.

title: Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
description:
Description
A Career at Clarius
Today, as many as 25 million medical professionals globally don’t have access to medical imaging, which is proven to improve patient care and reduce healthcare costs. That’s why we’re on a mission to make medical imaging accessible everywhere by delivering high-performance, affordable, and easy-to-use solutions powered by artificial intelligence and connected to the cloud.
By making Clarius your next career move, you’re joining a talented, innovative, and highly collaborative global team. You’re also joining a community that includes thousands of physicians worldwide who use Clarius to deliver better patient care! And you’re joining a thrice-certified Great Place to Work!
Your Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Manager to join our Enterprise Sales team
The Account Manager, Enterprise Sales, drives revenue growth and system-wide adoption of the Clarius Mobile Health portfolio, with a significant focus on enterprise sales across hospitals, health systems and IDNs, medical education, B2B and distribution. This role focuses on developing new business opportunities, executing sales strategies, and managing complex sales cycles for Clarius handheld ultrasound solutions. The Account Manager builds trusted relationships with key decision-makers, negotiates multi-year agreements, and collaborates cross-functionally to deliver value-based solutions
This is a remote role with up to 50 percent travel. We have multiple positions, hiring in Texas and Florida.
Your Responsibilities Include:

• Business Development: Identify and pursue new enterprise-level opportunities within hospitals, health systems, and IDNs, medical education, B2B and distribution.

• Sales Execution: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed revenue targets for handheld ultrasound product lines.

• Account Management: Build strong, trusted relationships with decision-makers (procurement teams, B2B partnerships, C-suite executives)

• Contract Negotiation: Lead complex negotiations, including multi-year agreements, pricing models, and partnership structures.

• Collaboration: Partner with clinical specialists, marketing, and product teams to deliver compelling demos, proposals, and value-based selling approaches.

• Market Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and customer feedback to inform sales strategy and product positioning.

• Reporting: Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting, CRM updates, and regular business reviews with leadership.

• Partnership Development: Identify, cultivate, and close strategic partnerships with multi-site B2B organizations to expand sales and drive scalable adoption of the Clarius Mobile Health portfolio. Build and manage a pipeline of high-value partners, negotiate and finalize agreements, and ensure smooth, streamlined integration of our products into partner operations.

• Distribution/Enterprise Partners: Identify and manage relationships with distributors and channel partners to expand market access and accelerate adoption.

• Educational Partners: Partner with universities, teaching hospitals, and training organizations to embed ultrasound into medical education and continuous learning programs.

• Explore co-marketing and co-education opportunities that strengthen the brand and drive adoption.

• Hold a valid driver’s license and have access to a vehicle; travel up to 50% is required

Your Experience So Far:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience

• 3-5 years of successful capital imaging equipment, software, or clinical sales experience, preferably with Enterprise or government accounts

• Experience with high-value, complex sales cycles

• Proficiency in spoken and written English

• Experience with sales quotas, forecasting, and a track record of exceeding sales goals

• Understanding of the ultrasound and medical imaging industry and basic clinical knowledge of anatomy

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

title: Senior Manager (Education)
description:

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

description:

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Associate Counsel, Commercial Transactions, who is best-in-class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

This is an early-career role on Sezzle's Legal team, working alongside our Senior Counsel, Commercial Transactions on the vendor contracts we buy under and the merchant agreements we sell under. Nearly all of this work is governed by US law and negotiated in English with US counterparties. You will build real transactional skills fast: drafting, negotiating, and closing agreements with growing independence, using our playbooks and Claude-enabled contract workflows. We are looking for someone who is business-first and practical, who wants to learn how to find the path to “yes” rather than lead with “no.”

What You'll Do:

• Vendor contracts. Review and negotiate NDAs, order forms, SOWs, and standard SaaS, services, data, and marketing agreements on Sezzle paper and counterparty paper, working from our playbooks and escalating non-standard terms.

• Merchant agreements. Prepare first drafts of merchant agreements, amendments, and onboarding terms, and turn counterparty redlines with guidance from senior lawyers on the team.

• Issue spotting. Identify the terms that carry real exposure (limitation of liability, indemnities, IP, data privacy and security, audit rights, termination, service levels) and summarize them in plain English for deal teams and senior counsel.

• Business support. Answer day-to-day contract questions from Sales, Partnerships, Procurement, Finance, Product, and Engineering with fast, practical guidance that starts from what the business is trying to achieve.

• AI workflows. Run contracts through our Claude-enabled review workflows, check the output critically, and help improve review playbooks and prompts as templates and positions change.

• Intake and lifecycle. Manage matters through our intake queue and contract lifecycle platform, run pre-signature checks on parties, exhibits, and signature authority, and keep renewals, amendments, and key obligations tracked.

• Templates and precedent. Help maintain contract templates, fallback positions, and a precedent library so the next deal moves faster.

• Compliance coordination. Work with Compliance and Procurement to confirm vendor and partner agreements include the third-party risk management and bank-partner oversight terms we require.

What We Look For:

• Law degree and admission to practice in LATAM (tarjeta profesional) or a US jurisdiction.

• 1 to 2 years of commercial, corporate, or transactional experience at a law firm or in-house, including internships, prácticas, or judicatura.

• Full professional fluency in written and spoken English, enough to read, draft, and discuss US-law governed contracts directly with US counterparties, plus native or fluent Spanish.

• Some hands-on exposure to drafting or reviewing commercial contracts in English.

title: Customer Care Specialist (němčina) - (ZKRÁCENÝ úvazek/20hod. týdně)
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.

Jako Customer Care Specialist se k nám přidáš na zkrácený úvazek 20 hodin týdně (možný je ale i plný úvazek). Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office (při plném úvazku).

 

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

 

CO OD TEBE POTŘEBUJEME

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role

- Němčina je nutnost (pokročilá úroveň) - psaná i mluvená

- Čeština/slovenština je nutnost

- Angličtina je výhodou / silným plusem - psaná i mluvená

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

 

CO Z TOHO BUDEŠ MÍT

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce? Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

title: Scientist, Plume Modeling and Forecasting
description:
Sunlight reflection may be the only available option, alongside dramatic emissions reductions, adaptation, and rapid scaling of carbon removal, to rapidly limit many climate impacts over the coming decades. But we don’t know nearly enough about it to make a scientifically-informed decision about potential deployment - and we’re not on a trajectory for rapid, legitimate decision making.
Reflective is a global, non-profit research organization aiming to radically accelerate the pace of sunlight reflection research. We equip the world with the data and tools needed to make informed decisions about sunlight reflection, fast enough to matter.
What you'll do
Reflective studies stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI) through modeling and, where the science requires it, by assessing the feasibility of small-scale outdoor experiments. Our modeling work includes AIDE-SAI, a linked set of machine-learning emulators that simulates SAI end to end, from stratospheric circulation through aerosol microphysics to radiation. Both the modeling framework and experiment feasibility assessment require better representation of plume evolution at scales our current global tools do not resolve: the global emulators only carry injected material once it has spread across a grid box, while a field study would need to forecast where a plume is and how it dilutes over days to weeks.
As Reflective ’s Scientist for Plume Modeling and Forecasting, you’ll own that scale. You’ll lead plume forecasting for balloon-based tracer campaigns run with external partners, which test forecasting methods without any aerosol release, and build Reflective ’s own forecasting capability out to the 24- to 72-hour horizons a field study would require. You’ll run plume-resolving simulations from release through dispersion and turn the results into dilution rates, an effective source term, and a parameterization the global framework can use. Should a field study proceed, you’ll serve as mission scientist.
The role sits between the multi-scale team and the experiment team and reports to Reflective ’s Head of Research, Marianna Linz. You’ll work daily with the OSSE Senior Scientist, who owns observing-system design and parameter estimation and runs that work from your plume simulations; the In-Situ Observing Lead and instrument specialists, who own the instruments and rely on you to tell them where to look; the experiment operations lead, who owns aircraft contracting, shipping, permitting, and in-country operations; and Reflective ’s external forecasting and modeling partners.
Responsibilities

• Lead plume forecasting for balloon-based tracer campaigns run with external partners, working within the partner’s data assimilation and forecasting process while developing in-house capabilities. These campaigns test forecasting methods and are distinct from the potential aerosol microphysics experiment.

• Develop and evaluate plume forecasting capabilities over the 24- to 72-hour horizons a potential field study would require, documenting performance limits and their implications for feasibility.

• Quantify forecast uncertainty well enough to plan against it: where the ensemble spread puts the plume, how that spread grows with lead time, and what it implies for search patterns and instrument settings.

• Translate forecast results into requirements for the observing team, including viewing geometry, altitude, timing, and expected plume extent for daytime visualization systems.

• Model detailed plume evolution to support numerical experiments that test candidate observing suites and sampling cadences at realistic density and instrument fidelity.

• Verify forecasts from each tracer campaign against what was observed and report plainly where they failed.

• Own Reflective ’s plume-scale modeling: large-eddy and plume-resolving simulations of injected material from release through dispersion, covering the regime the global emulators cannot resolve.

• Turn plume-scale results into inputs

title: Central Reach Administrative Coordinator

We are looking for a friendly, personable, and detail-oriented CentralReach Administrative Coordinator to join our client's team. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience using CentralReach who enjoys working with people, maintaining accurate records, and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of an ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) business.

•
CentralReach Management: Navigate CentralReach confidently to complete assigned administrative tasks and maintain accurate client records.

•
Data Accuracy: Ensure information is entered correctly, records are kept up to date, and errors or discrepancies are identified and reported promptly.

Confidentiality and Privacy: Protect sensitive client information and follow all company privacy, confidentiality, and data-handling procedures.

•
Issue Reporting: Escalate unresolved issues, system errors, or discrepancies to the appropriate supervisor when necessary.

•
Administrative Support: Assist with additional administrative responsibilities as required to support the team's operational needs.

•
Hands-on CentralReach experience is essential.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate professionally with families and colleagues.

• Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate concerns.

Preferred Experience

• Experience with clinical or client record management, healthcare administration, or similar documentation processes.
